name: spfx-wasm-samples-wasm-image-upload
title: WASM Image Upload
shortDescription: Optimize selected images locally in a worker and explicitly upload the measured output to SharePoint.
longDescription: Targets SPFx 1.24.0; current packages remain pinned to published stable SPFx 1.23.2 while the 1.24.0 stable release is pending. Uses a browser-native image worker and actual runtime measurements.
